name: dev-flow
description: Plan, implement, review and QA-impact flow run by subagents and guarded by hooks: /dev-flow:dev-plan, /dev-flow:dev-implement, /dev-flow:dev-qa-impact, plus /dev-flow:load-flow (pick a task up from the plans folder) and /dev-flow:clear-flow (switch this session's flow off); implements the regression-test-first fix plans the dev-debug plugin writes from a confirmed diagnosis. The main session commits each package and fix round, and pushes and opens the PR when you ask; hooks block subagent pushes, PRs and commits, force pushes, discards, comments, merges and publishing (Bash, PowerShell, MCP), enforce per-agent and per-package write limits, spawn each stage agent only at its plan status, require build/test evidence in verify.log, detect any other change to the working tree, and notify at the human gates. The guards follow the session that runs the flow: another Claude Code session on the same checkout is not guarded by it. Bash 3.2+ hooks run on Linux, macOS and Windows (Git Bash).
